derived_from.note: Attempts and grades were recorded by the evaluation run of 2026-11-17 and copied here unchanged except for the system names. That run used the same baseline and agent logic as this code: replaying every attempt through this code gives the same prompts, user messages, schema structure, steps, answers and token counts. Two later edits did not change what the systems or the judge read: the task file gained type, question_en and rubric (question and intended are byte-identical), and three reply-schema descriptions were shortened (internal names removed).

interpretation: Cohorts can use different model, judge, corpus and agent policy. Compare systems within a cohort. Pooled counts describe coverage.
